batchBorrowAccounting.note: Arrival cohort counts eventual successful completions of borrow-phase arrivals; completion window counts successful completions timestamped inside that phase. Neither counts rejected or censored work as completed. Missing timestamps yield unknown values.

recovery.note: These are observed vLLM engine states after the last arrival. They do not imply that MoFlux reclaimed GPU execution or KV-cache blocks.

scheduledReturn.note: Engine-wide snapshot after the scheduled return boundary, and delay to the first sampled empty queue. Includes sampling delay, may precede actual demand or grant restoration, and does not establish sustained clearance or interactive waiting time. Later queues may form.

demandReturn.timebase: Sampler offsets are milliseconds from the arm's measured start. Generator-side instants are shifted by loadgenSkewMs onto the same origin; when that skew is unknown they are reported as null rather than aligned by assumption.

backendAvailability.selection: first planned interactive return request, attempt 1; never replaced by a success

engineCorrelation.note: Offsets share the arm sampler origin. Each snapshot is the first sample at or after its anchor; inspect sample lag. Borrowed occupancy is admission-side only. Engine gauges are aggregate and cannot establish batch KV residency, interactive queue time, or physical reclamation. Missing anchors or samples remain unknown.

tyrRestoration.framing: Admission slots are Tyr-local and can be taken back from a borrower by an expiring deadline (enforced). Upstream token capacity cannot be reclaimed once in flight at the provider: an unlent slice is withheld before lending (allocation-enforced), and everything else is a wall-clock objective. Tyr reports upstream cancellation as unverified and this benchmark never restates it as reclaimed capacity.

criticalWindow.note: Samples identical to their predecessor are omitted; the first and last sample in the interval are always kept so the boundaries are observed rather than inferred.

metricDefinitions.batchBorrowGoodputRps: Eventual successful completions of borrow-phase arrivals / borrow duration; not completion throughput within that window.
metricDefinitions.mofluxBatchBorrowDeltaVsStaticRps: Paired difference in arrival-cohort goodput; historical gate name retained.
metricDefinitions.interactiveContentionTtftP95Ms: Successful requests only; read alongside SLO goodput and rejections.

gates.reason: all four arms must complete

gates.threshold: one hash
gates.reason: every arm must replay the same immutable request trace
a saturated load generator invalidates the run

gates.threshold: no missing required metrics
gates.reason: queue, occupancy, KV, preemption, and timing claims require their engine metrics

gates.threshold: exact fixed completion tokens plus prompt usage for every success in every arm
gates.reason: HTTP or stream completion without generated-token evidence is not successful inference

gates.threshold: positive measured TTFT and end-to-end histogram counts per arm
gates.reason: metric names alone do not prove that vLLM executed any measured request

gates.threshold: >0 per arm
gates.reason: a native Metal experiment must record the vLLM process tree and its host pressure

gates.threshold: zero scrape/sample errors
gates.reason: missing intervals can hide the short queue, KV, or restoration transition under test

gates.threshold: per arm: pressure samples present and error-free, critical <= 0, swap-out <= 256 MiB
gates.reason: a swapping host degrades Docker networking, control-plane requests, and engine latency together; that is host contention, not an arm effect

gates.threshold: at least one sample and zero errors per managed arm
gates.reason: admission restoration cannot be reconstructed through gaps in Tyr/controller sampling

gates.threshold: concurrencyLimited>0 and budgetLimited=0
gates.reason: the 3/1 concurrency treatment must bind without turning into a token-budget experiment

gates.threshold: 0 refusals with a zero capacity envelope
gates.reason: a managed arm that refuses work because it holds no live grant is measuring a control-plane gap, not the 3/1 treatment
at least one direct arm must show a non-empty vLLM waiting queue

gates.threshold: >0 req/s in at least one direct arm
gates.reason: an all-zero direct comparison cannot support priority or non-inferiority claims

gates.threshold: same vLLM/plugin/model/Mac/capacity
gates.reason: only the declared scheduling/admission policy may vary

gates.threshold: observed vLLM/plugin/model commit/Apple platform and pinned engine arguments
gates.reason: a stable null or silently changed setting is not a controlled runtime

gates.threshold: darwin/arm64 for every arm
gates.reason: Metal evidence is invalid unless every arm ran natively on Apple Silicon
FCFS is isolated to its control arm; all other arms use vLLM priority scheduling
engine faults and torn streams are not admission-policy outcomes

gates.threshold: 320 blocks of 16 tokens in every arm
gates.reason: the scheduler's KV pool must be the pinned one, read from the engine, not assumed from the command line

gates.threshold: peak KV usage >= 0.9 in at least one direct arm
gates.reason: a KV-pressure workload that never filled the pool did not test what it exists to test
the one-slot allocation-enforced reserve must never disappear from a usable grant

gates.threshold: present
gates.reason: restoration and unlent-floor claims require controller-side evidence

gates.threshold: >=1 concurrent and >=12288 tokens withheld
gates.reason: the allocator's gauges, not the submitted policy, must confirm the native reserve

gates.threshold: complete bounded event window and zero unsafe handoffs
gates.reason: a grant must not move before required drain acknowledgements

gates.threshold: >0 measured per-resource episodes
gates.reason: sampled grant recovery must agree with Latchflo's per-resource restoration record
